description: A round white base with a threaded center sits on the table, and a separate white cross-shaped bench piece is nearby. The left hand rests near the base to steady it, while the right hand picks up the cross-shaped piece, brings it over the base, and lowers its connector onto the center post, adjusting and slightly turning it to seat it in place; the base becomes a two-hand object as the right hand aligns it and the left hand keeps it from shifting.
